name: Debt Instrument
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-037 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.

Boundary hold: the aggregate owns instrument identity, contractual terms, schedule formulas, options, covenant terms and change lineage while issuance, position, payment, ledger, observation and legal-case masters remain external.
Relation hold: WM-ECO-037 EXTEND WM-ECO-005 remains a candidate relation because the former Credit / Security category is marked for split.
Debt-class hold: loan, sovereign, municipal, corporate, covered, structured, securitized, Islamic, convertible, sustainability-linked and distressed debt need separate validation profiles.
Jurisdiction hold: formation, enforceability, disclosure, tax, insolvency, security interest, limitation, consumer protection and remedy depend on jurisdiction and instrument class.
Accounting hold: IFRS pages establish boundaries but licensed text, jurisdictional adoption and entity-specific conclusions remain outside this draft; no full IFRS conformance is claimed.
State hold: instrument, issuance, position, scheduled, due, paid, posted, observed, rated, defaulted and legally enforced states remain independent.
Value hold: original, authorized, issued and outstanding principal and carrying amount, fair value, market price and recovery remain separately sourced, timed and currency-qualified.
Security hold: secured status, collateral identity, value, perfection, enforceability and priority require separate evidence and authority.
FIBO release hold: master/latest ontology pages are development artifacts; implementation conformance requires an exact production release and licensing review.
Interoperability hold: every ISO, FIGI, FIBO, XBRL, API, document or RDF projection needs exact release pins, conformance evidence and semantic-loss declarations.
Review hold: debt-capital-markets, lending, treasury, legal, accounting, tax, risk, data, security, records and independent external review are outstanding.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
